### Overview
The 223-amino-acid sequence is an **exact match** to the reviewed *Histophilus somni* ribonuclease III (RNase III; UniProt **B0USS1**). It is annotated as a **Mg²⁺-dependent endoribonuclease** (EC 3.1.26.3) that cleaves double-stranded RNA. Its reported roles include processing rRNA precursors and certain mRNAs and tRNAs; processing of type II CRISPR RNAs applies only if such a system is present in the organism. The reference annotation places it in the cytoplasm as a homodimer.

**Sequence-derived attributes:** estimated molecular mass **25.23 kDa**, theoretical pI **8.72**, and GRAVY **−0.405**. These are computational estimates, not experimental measurements. Functional details are based on the exact match to the reviewed reference annotation; biological context may depend on the organism.
